name: Herod
summary: A king who attacked the church, killing James with the sword and putting Peter in prison. When the people hailed him as a god and he did not give God the glory, an angel of the Lord struck him and he died.

key_moments.title: Kills James and Jails Peter
key_moments.description: Herod the king began to harm the church, and he killed John's brother James with the sword. Seeing that this pleased the Jews, he arrested Peter too and put him in prison under heavy guard.

key_moments.title: Loses Peter from His Prison
key_moments.description: On the night before Herod planned to bring Peter out, an angel woke Peter, the chains dropped from his hands, and he walked out past the guards. Peter then knew for sure that the Lord had rescued him from Herod.

key_moments.title: Struck Down by an Angel
key_moments.description: Herod went down to Caesarea, where one day he sat on his throne in royal robes and gave a speech. The people shouted that a god was speaking, not a man, and because he did not give God the glory, an angel of the Lord struck him and he died.
